the detailed measurement of neutron transportation and its Monte Carlo simulation for the 12-GeV proton transport line to the access maze.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Monte Carlo simulation is an indispensable tool to estimate the neutron transportation phenomena in the accelerator facility.

the Monte Carlo calculation of the neutron transport from the beam-line tunnel to the access maze is feasible and reliable, if the electric wire cables, door walls and other important structures are taken into account in the simulation.
the neutron transportation phenomena from a beam line to a maze can be precisely simulated by the Monte Carlo method.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Monte Carlo simulation of the neutron transportation phenomena from the beam-line tunnel to the maze can be successfully carried out if the detailed spatial information is used as the input data.
the neutron transportation phenomena in the maze can be understood by considering the successive source of neutrons from high-energy particles and the effect of door walls and electric wires.

we have to consider not only the neutron transportation but also other transportation phenomena such as high-energy particles, charged particles, and photons when we design the shielding system in the case of a high-energy beam transport system with many beam loss points and a long beam line tunnel.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Monte Carlo calculation can reproduce our experimental results and it is useful for the neutron transportation analysis at a 12 GeV accelerator.
the Monte Carlo calculation is a useful and reliable tool for the design and analysis of the neutron transportation phenomena in the beam line tunnel and the access maze of the accelerator.
the MARS15 code can be used for the neutron transportation analysis from beam lines to access mazes.
